notes: The standard Microsoft Entra sign-in: a white card over a soft abstract background with the Microsoft logo, 'Sign in', an 'Email or phone' field, a 'Can't access your account?' link and a blue Next button. A separate 'Sign-in options' bar sits under the card, and the footer has Terms of use and Privacy and cookies links. The email-first field is the only visible method. The page names neither the requesting app nor any permissions at this stage.
